arguments.command: python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx'); print(df.to_string())"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', header=None)
# Expenses rows: 9..20 (0-indexed) with amounts in column 2
exp = df.iloc[9:21, 2]
print(exp.tolist())
print('Total:', exp.sum())
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', header=None)
print(df.head(24).to_string())
print('---')
# Find expense line items: rows where col C has a value and col B is an item label under EXPENSES section
start = df.index[df[0].eq('EXPENSES')][0]
end = df.index[df[0].eq('Total Expenses')][0]
print('EXPENSES at row', start, 'Total Expenses at row', end)
items = df.loc[start+1:end-1]
print(items.to_string())
print('Total:', items[2].sum())
"
